# Queller Fisher

> > Queller Fisher is a New York-based personal injury law firm specializing in vehicle accident litigation, providing compensation recovery for victims of car crashes, truck accidents, motorcycle collisions, and transit incidents across NYC.

Queller Fisher (operating as Washor Kool Sosa Maiorana & Schwartz, LLP) focuses exclusively on accident compensation and negligence claims throughout New York and New York City. The firm handles diverse vehicle accident types including car accidents, truck collisions, motorcycle crashes, and public transit incidents, offering free consultations and pursuing maximum compensation for injured victims.
